description: Defines the TimeInterface interface for obtaining system time with methods for request time, request microtime, current time, and current microtime.

classes.name: TimeInterface
classes.description: Interface for obtaining system time with methods for request time, microtime, current time, and current microtime.

methods.name: getRequestTime
methods.description: Returns the timestamp for the current request, used at the start of a request, with fallback to system time.

methods.name: getRequestMicroTime
methods.description: Returns the request timestamp with microsecond precision, used at the start of a request.

methods.name: getCurrentTime
methods.description: Returns the current system time as an integer.

methods.name: getCurrentMicroTime
methods.description: Returns the current system time with microsecond precision.
